stories.title: France-Belgique : le résumé du renversant succès des Bleus en Ligue des nations, sortis du piège des Diables rouges par un formidable Michael Olise

en.title: France-Belgium: summary of the stunning success of the Blues in the Nations League, escaping the trap of the Red Devils through a formidable Michael Olise
en.summary: France defeated Belgium 4-1 in a Nations League match, with Bayern Munich's Michael Olise scoring twice and providing an assist after entering in the second half at the Stade de France.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Blocus des lycées : 984 personnes interpellées ce lundi, 715 blessés côté forces de l’ordre depuis le début de la mobilisation

en.title: LIVE - High school blockades: 984 people arrested Monday, 715 law enforcement officers injured since start of mobilization
en.summary: Over 5,000 people, mostly minors, have been detained since violence began during high school protests in mid-September, with 14 ordered into provisional detention.

stories.title: Un adolescent de 15 ans a eu "la main arrachée" par une grenade près d'un lycée de Lens, une enquête de l'IGPN ouverte

en.title: 15-year-old student had hand severed by grenade near school in Lens; police inspectorate opens investigation
en.summary: A 15-year-old student attending Auguste-Béhal vocational school in Lens, Pas-de-Calais, suffered severe injury during Monday's school-related disturbances, triggering an official inquiry.

stories.title: Transfigurée par ses remplaçants, l'équipe de France renverse la Belgique en Ligue des nations

en.title: Transformed by its substitutes, the French team defeats Belgium in the Nations League
en.summary: France beat Belgium 4-1 in a Nations League match, with substitute appearances by Désiré Doué, Michael Olise and Rayan Cherki delivering a decisive impact and marking Zinédine Zidane's first victory on home soil.

stories.title: 🔴 Ligue des nations : la France renverse puis punit la Belgique

en.title: Nations League: France turns around and defeats Belgium
en.summary: France defeated Belgium in a Nations League match.

stories.title: Main arrachée, mâchoire fracturée : dix enquêtes de l’IGPN ouvertes en lien avec les blocages des lycées, annonce le gouvernement

en.title: Hand severed, jaw fractured: ten IGPN investigations opened linked to high school blockades, government announces
en.summary: The French government has opened ten investigations by the police oversight body following high school blockades that have injured at least 215 students. A left-wing lawmaker has referred cases of alleged police violence to prosecutors.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : les accusations de violences policières se multiplient à la veille d’une importante journée de mobilisation

en.title: High school blockades: accusations of police violence multiply on the eve of major mobilization day
en.summary: Protest movements over high school blockades resumed Monday with accusations of police violence mounting as a major demonstration is planned for Tuesday. The government has proposed five initiatives to address the movement while denying excessive use of force.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : un lycéen gravement blessé à la veille d'un "acte III" mardi

en.title: High school blockades: a student gravely injured on the eve of a third act Tuesday
en.summary: A 15-year-old student lost a hand during incidents Monday as high school blockades continue with union support planned for Tuesday's escalated protest. Several establishments remained closed with multiple violent incidents reported.

stories.title: Ligue des nations : la France de Zidane qualifiée ce lundi en quarts de finale si...

en.title: Nations League: Zidane's France qualify Monday for quarterfinals if...
en.summary: France can secure quarterfinal qualification Monday against Belgium, needing a victory and a favorable result in the Italy-Turkey match for advancement in the competition.

stories.title: Loïk le Priol, condamné à vingt-six ans de prison pour le meurtre de Federico Martin Aramburu à Paris, fait appel

en.title: Loïk le Priol, sentenced to twenty-six years in prison for the murder of Federico Martin Aramburu in Paris, appeals
en.summary: Loïk le Priol has appealed his twenty-six-year prison sentence for Federico Martin Aramburu's murder in Paris. Co-defendant Romain Bouvier, sentenced to nineteen years, also filed an appeal.

stories.title: Un cas de peste soupçonné en Sibérie : la Russie assure que « la situation reste sous contrôle », et les Etats-Unis, qu’ils « surveillent de près », après la mort d’une chercheuse d’une pneumonie à l’origine indéterminée

en.title: Suspected plague case in Siberia: Russia assures that "the situation remains under control", and the United States that they "are monitoring closely", following the death of a researcher from pneumonia of undetermined origin
en.summary: A laboratory technician at an Irkutsk plague institute in Siberia died from unidentified pneumonia. Russia says the situation is controlled while the United States says it is closely monitoring the case.

stories.title: Blocage des lycées : à Lens, un adolescent a eu la main arrachée en ramassant une grenade lors d’affrontements avec la police

en.title: School blockades: in Lens, a teenager lost his hand after picking up a grenade during clashes with police
en.summary: A police source indicates a teenager lost his hand after retrieving a dispersal grenade to throw back at officers during school-related protests in Lens.

stories.title: Soutien : le salon AD2S porté par le contexte international

en.title: Support: the AD2S trade show buoyed by international context
en.summary: The Aerospace & Defence Support and Services trade show took place in late September at Bordeaux Mérignac air base, with military and industrial participants focused on combat maintenance concepts.

stories.title: Tribune. Financement des litiges par des tiers : solution stratégique pour l'aéronautique et la défense

en.title: Commentary: Third-party litigation financing as strategic solution for aerospace and defense
en.summary: An opinion piece discusses third-party litigation financing as a strategic approach for companies in the aerospace and defense sectors.

stories.title: Vendre les actifs non stratégiques de la Caisse des dépôts : la Cour des comptes cible un portefeuille de 31,6 milliards

en.title: Court of Auditors targets Caisse des dépôts non-strategic assets worth 31.6 billion euros for sale
en.summary: France's Court of Auditors is urging the Caisse des dépôts to divest non-strategic holdings valued at 31.6 billion euros in 2026 and return proceeds to the state while preserving group revenues.

stories.title: Portrait : générale de brigade Solène Le Floch, commandante de la Brigade aérienne d'assaut projection

en.title: Profile: Brigadier General Solène Le Floch, Commander of the Airborne Assault Projection Brigade
en.summary: Brigadier General Solène Le Floch commands the Airborne Assault Projection Brigade and specializes in operations on unprepared terrain.

stories.title: Dette publique : comment la restructuration d’un État frappe les ménages modestes

en.title: Public Debt: How State Restructuring Affects Modest Households
en.summary: When states default on debt, modest households bear the heaviest costs through reduced credit availability, degraded public services, and employment threats, rather than bondholders.
